subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ Did you change the [set volume] parameter?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What might be a reasonable volume for the melody to be played at?


Solution: 

Value in the [set volume] block is decreased from 255, to a value smaller than 255.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, the volume is so loud that it distracts the user from playing the game! 


Fix the bugs in the code so that the game begins with a lower volume.

subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Help the puppy collect the bones and avoid the chocolate bars!

validationItems.text: Volume value decreased from 300 to a number smaller than 300
validationItems.failureText: Check the value in the [set volume] block.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓ Did you change the tempo parameter in the [play melody] block that runs else score is 3 or higher?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja:

❓How fast should you make the tempo parameter, so that there is a noticeable change in the pace of the melody?


Solution:

Tempo parameter in the [play melody] block in the [if] conditional of the Player/Projectile [on sprite overlaps sprite] block is increased from 150, to a value greater than 250.
steps.instructions:
When the Player earns more than three points, the melody’s tempo remains the same.


Fix the bugs in the code so that the melody’s tempo increases in speed when the Player has three or more points.

subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Help the puppy collect the bones and avoid the chocolate bars!

validationItems.failureText: Check the tempo parameter in the [play melody] block in the [if] conditional of the [on sprite overlaps sprite] block.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 4 of Yellow Belt! In this level, you’ll learn about using animation and music to make your projects even more awesome! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 4:

badges.title: The Ol’ Razzle Dazzle
badges.description: Use animation and music to enhance a project.

badges.title: Saturday Morning Cartoons
badges.description: Use both image and movement animation in a project.

badges.title: On and On and On and...
badges.description: Repeat a melody or sound on loop in the background of a project.

badges.title: Original Score
badges.description: Compose a custom melody in MakeCode.
